richiami.difetto: Components in the front differential may not be made to the correct standard. In particular the pinion carrier stud may move or crack when in 4WD mode during heavy or off road use..
richiami.rimedio: Install an updated front gear case kit.

richiami.difetto: Department for Transport tests have shown that the hydraulic parking brake could fail to hold the ATV on a slope.
richiami.rimedio: Remove the hydraulic parking brake and refit with mechanical.
richiami.titolo: HYDRAULIC PARKING BRAKE DOES NOT MEET UK LEGISLATION
